site.title: Cutefish - A beautiful, effortless Linux distribution
site.description: Cutefish, also known as CutefishOS, is a Linux distribution built around Cutefish Desktop, a calm, fast desktop environment with its own compositor, toolkit and applications.
home.title: Simple. Calm. Yours.
home.lead: Cutefish is a Linux distribution built around Cutefish Desktop, designed from the compositor up so every part looks and moves the same way. Your agents can use it too, whenever you allow them.
features.agents.title: Built for agents
features.agents.body: Agents such as Claude Code and Codex can see and use the desktop once you allow it, and stop the moment you say so.
features.shell.title: Dock, Launcher and Overview
features.shell.body: A dock for running and favourite applications, a full-screen launcher, and an overview of every window and desk.
features.desks.title: Virtual desks
features.desks.body: Spread your work over several desks and move between them with a three-finger sideways swipe.
features.glass.title: Glass surfaces
features.glass.body: Panels, menus and the dock blur and tint the wallpaper behind them.
features.compositor.title: Own compositor and toolkit
features.compositor.body: cutefish-compositor draws the shell, window effects and animations itself, and every application is built on cutefish-toolkit, a native C++ toolkit drawn with Skia.
features.apps.title: Applications
features.apps.body: Files, Terminal, Settings, Calendar, System Monitor, Text Editor, Video Player and screen capture come with the desktop.

about.title: About
about.lead: Cutefish, formerly CutefishOS, is a beautifully designed Linux distribution that works out of the box, with Cutefish Desktop at its heart.
about.body: Cutefish Desktop is its own Wayland compositor and shell, a native toolkit drawn with Skia, and a set of applications, all developed together.
about.openBody: Every part of Cutefish, this website included, is open source. The code and its whole history are public on GitHub.
about.licenseBsd: Most of Cutefish is under the BSD 3-Clause License.
about.licenseGpl: The terminal, which carries Konsole code, and the icon theme, based on Colloid, are under the GNU GPL 3.0.
about.licenseWallpapers: The wallpapers are under the Unsplash License.
about.buildBody: Nothing we publish is built on anyone's own computer. A public workflow on GitHub Actions
about.buildFresh: builds everything from the code on GitHub;
about.buildSign: signs the package repository, with a key only that workflow can use;
about.buildTrace: records which commit and which build made every file, in a public log nobody can rewrite.
about.buildCheck: So you can check a download yourself instead of taking our word for it.
about.involvedBody: Bug reports, fixes and translations are welcome as issues and pull requests on GitHub. If you would like to support the work, you can sponsor Cutefish monthly or once through GitHub Sponsors.
footer.tagline: Cutefish, formerly CutefishOS, is a beautiful, effortless Linux distribution built around Cutefish Desktop.
